# SubQ API

> SubQ serves its models over an HTTP API at `https://api.subq.ai/v1`. SubQ Snap Preview (`subq-snap-preview`, public preview) returns typed decisions with probabilities from the Decisions API. SubQ Preview (`subq-preview`, early access) is a long-context model behind OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions and Responses endpoints.

- Send `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` on every request. The examples read the key from the `SUBQ_API_KEY` environment variable.
- The Decisions API (`POST /v1/systemone`) has its own typed contract: noul (yes/no), choice, and score questions, with errors in a `detail` object. It is not OpenAI-compatible.
- Chat Completions and Responses are OpenAI-compatible. Use an OpenAI SDK with its base URL set to `https://api.subq.ai/v1`.
- Release stages: public preview is open to every account. Early access is enabled per account; other keys get `403`. Both can change before general availability. `GET /v1/models` lists the models your key can use.
- Every link below is the page as Markdown. A page with a release stage starts with a `Status:` line.

## Get started

- [Quickstart](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/index.md): Send your first SubQ Decisions API request. Public preview.
- [API overview](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api.md): How SubQ's OpenAI-compatible API fits into a developer integration.
- [Authentication](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/authentication.md): Authenticate SubQ API requests with bearer tokens.
- [Data retention](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/data-retention.md): How long SubQ stores prompts, completions, and conversation history.
- [Models](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/models.md): Supported SubQ model IDs and what each one accepts.

## SubQ Snap Preview (public preview)

- [Decisions API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/decisions-api.md): Turn text or structured state into typed decisions with probabilities and confidence.

## SubQ Preview (early access)

- [Sending files](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/file-inputs.md): Send documents inline as base64, or upload once and reference them by file_id on Chat Completions or Responses.
- [Structured outputs](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/structured-outputs.md): Return JSON that matches your schema, from the Responses API or Chat Completions.
- [Function calling](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/using-the-api/function-calling.md): Connect SubQ models to your application with OpenAI-compatible tools, on Chat Completions or the Responses API.
- [Responses API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/responses-api.md): Stateful inference with system instructions, web search, and server-managed conversation history.
- [Chat Completions API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/chat-completions-api.md): Create OpenAI-compatible chat completions with SubQ.
- [Files API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/files-api.md): Upload, list, retrieve, and delete org-scoped files for use with Chat Completions and Responses.
- [Conversations API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/conversations-api.md): Manage conversation history as a stored resource — create, retrieve, update, delete, and manage the items inside it.

## API reference

- [Models API](https://docs.subq.ai/markdown/endpoints/models-api.md): List the model IDs available to your API key.
